title: Vitalizing Rich Polish Pork Bowl
description: A rich and tender Polish dish featuring pork, served in a Korean brass bowl, perfect for curing hangovers, made with cold water and steam, and low in carbs.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the pork shoulder, cold water, caraway seeds, black pepper, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the pork from the pot and let it cool.
Shred the cooled pork into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the sour cream, garlic, and lemon juice.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the shredded pork into a Korean brass bowl.
Spoon some of the sour cream mixture over the top of the pork.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
